title: Jesus Heals Two Blind Men near Jericho
description: Two blind men sat by the road outside Jericho and cried out to Jesus for mercy. Even though the crowd told them to be quiet, they shouted even louder. Jesus had compassion, touched their eyes, and immediately they received their sight and followed him.

versions.title: Jesus Heals Two Blind Men
versions.description: Two blind men near Jericho cried out to Jesus for mercy, and he healed them so that they received their sight and followed him.
